in_marathi.name: Kamakshi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Desire or Longing for the Divine
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kamakshi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kamakshi is a form of the goddess Parvati, who is known to fulfill the deepest desires of her devotees. Her name is derived from 'Kama' (desire) and 'Kshi' (fulfillment). She is often depicted with a lotus in her hand, symbolizing the fulfillment of spiritual desires.
